comments.author: @edmakan1197
comments.text: I went up the steps of the Batu Caves at least a half dozen times back in the 80's and 90's. It tended to be a hot and humid climb to the top. They were not painted back then. After a few hours it was a bus ride further north to Templer Park to walk around and then cool off in the waterfalls. Later back into the city for a murtabak at a local Indian restaurant. Spent a lot of time in Penang and also the Cameron Highlands. Those were the days. Left Malaysia in May 2002 and never have been back. I miss Malaysia.
